<section class="page-hero"><h1>현지 조사와 순례</h1></section>
<main class="content"><div class="content-inner fieldwork-index">
<p class="lead">사찰, 건축물, 고고학 유적에 대한 현지 조사 기록, 연구 답사 경로와 순례에 관한 노트.</p>
<section class="fieldwork-index-section"><h2>방문지</h2><ul class="fieldwork-place-list"><li><a href="/ko/fieldwork-pilgrimages/phat-tich/"><strong>팟틱 사원 (佛跡寺)</strong></a> <span>— 베트남 · 박닌</span></li><li><a href="/ko/fieldwork-pilgrimages/but-thap/"><strong>붓탑 사원 (寧福寺)</strong></a> <span>— 베트남 · 박닌</span></li><li><a href="/ko/fieldwork-pilgrimages/sakya/"><strong>사캬 사원</strong></a> <span>— 티베트 · 짱</span></li><li><a href="/ko/fieldwork-pilgrimages/mount-hiei/"><strong>히에이산</strong></a> <span>— 일본 · 교토 / 오쓰</span></li><li><a href="/ko/fieldwork-pilgrimages/rice-university-houston/"><strong>Rice University, Houston, Texas</strong></a> <span>— 미국 · 휴스턴, 텍사스</span></li></ul></section>
<section class="fieldwork-index-section"><h2>지도</h2><div id="fieldwork-map" style="height:430px;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin:1rem 0 2.5rem"></div></section>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" crossorigin="">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js" crossorigin=""></script>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",function(){
  const m=L.map("fieldwork-map");
  L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png",{maxZoom:18,attribution:"&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors"}).addTo(m);
  const bounds=[];
  function addMarker(coords,html){L.marker(coords).addTo(m).bindPopup(html);bounds.push(coords);}
  addMarker([21.09650,106.02440],'<strong>팟틱 사원 (佛跡寺)</strong><br>베트남 · 박닌<br><a href="/ko/fieldwork-pilgrimages/phat-tich/">답사기 읽기</a>');
  addMarker([21.06103,106.02225],'<strong>붓탑 사원 (寧福寺)</strong><br>베트남 · 박닌<br><a href="/ko/fieldwork-pilgrimages/but-thap/">답사기 읽기</a>');
  addMarker([28.905,88.018],document.querySelector('.fieldwork-place-list a[href*="/sakya/"]').innerHTML+'<br>'+document.querySelector('.fieldwork-place-list a[href*="/sakya/"]').nextElementSibling.textContent.replace(/^—\s*/,'')+'<br><a href="'+document.querySelector('.fieldwork-place-list a[href*="/sakya/"]').getAttribute('href')+'">답사기 읽기</a>');
  addMarker([35.07068,135.84139],'<strong>히에이산</strong><br>일본 · 교토 / 오쓰<br><a href="/ko/fieldwork-pilgrimages/mount-hiei/">답사기 읽기</a>');
  addMarker([29.7174,-95.4018],'<strong>Rice University, Houston, Texas</strong><br>미국 · 휴스턴, 텍사스<br><a href="/ko/fieldwork-pilgrimages/rice-university-houston/">답사기 읽기</a>');
  m.fitBounds(bounds,{padding:[35,35],maxZoom:5});
});
</script>

</div></main>
